item.title: Madonna’s ‘Confessions II’ Checks In At No. 1 on ARIA Chart
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update from Australia! We've got the scoop on the ARIA charts, and it's all about the Queen of Pop. Madonna is back on top with her latest album, Confessions II, marking her 13th number one album in Australia. That's an impressive feat, putting her in elite company alongside Jimmy Barnes, The Beatles, and Taylor Swift."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Madonna's got a staggering 22 top 10 albums under her belt, and this latest achievement unseats Olivia Rodrigo from the top spot. Meanwhile, newcomer Sienna Spiro makes a strong debut at number three with her album Visitor. And if you're a fan of classic rock, you'll be excited to know that Deep Purple is back with their 24th studio album, Splat!, which enters the chart at number 19."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Over on the singles chart, Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' takes the top spot for the fifth time, while Sombr makes a notable climb with 'My Body Isn't Ready', up to number 27. That's her fifth top 30 appearance in under two years. It's been a big week for music in Australia, and we can't wait to see what's next. That's all for now - thanks for tuning in!"
[Outro music plays]
